**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement satisfies the MINCOMMIT preferred position:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — expressly states "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," limits fees to Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and confirms that declining to enter another Order Form "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — prohibits Vendor from imposing any "minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form, closing the back-door route to a de facto commitment.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no "minimum-volume" (or exclusivity/MFC) commitment.

I also checked the only other "shortfall" hits (§§ 22.2–22.3): those concern usage-audit underpayments, i.e. a true-up for services actually consumed, not a take-or-pay penalty — consistent with the playbook. No volume caps on Customer usage appear, and § 1.6 leaves quantities to be set per Order Form.
